//: Strict TS baseline. Every package extends this and declares its own
`references` so TS project references mechanically enforce the five-layer
one-way dependency order: core -> model -> workflows -> tools -> app.
A reference pointing the wrong way (e.g. core -> model) is a build error,
which keeps packages/core free of any framework import (AI SDK / Drizzle /
Playwright must be invisible to it).
